user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to display in ChatGPT search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in your site's robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Visits only landing pages submitted as ads to ensure policy compliance.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content that may be used in model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in your site's robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages when users ask questions or interact via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development, utility, and safety.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content at users' direction when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests to access websites in response to user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content for search optimization and relevance in search results.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for Google Search indexes and other product crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for video-related Google Search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping including the Shopping tab in Google Search.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler fetching publicly accessible content for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites for internal research and product teams.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across sites for product teams and research.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across sites for product teams and research.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features and collects data across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Web search crawling and rendering across public web pages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines data usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Controls usage of crawled data; does not crawl pages directly.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs for registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content URLs on Apple Podcasts.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to display title, description, and thumbnail.
user_agents.scope: Content from apps or websites shared across Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, and citations in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for improving advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training foundation AI models and direct product indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links requested by users and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links fetched to help AI navigate websites and complete user tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: General web crawling to improve Amazon products, services, and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use noarchive, noindex, or none robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to make it eligible to appear in Amazon search experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use noindex or none robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetching initiated by user queries on Amazon services like Alexa.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open copy of internet data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset sample of the web for Open Data dataset archive.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent CCBot or request addition to opt-out registry.
